canonical_data: the working tree, project instructions, agent and skill definitions, and resumable local sessions
current_repo_note: Forked from the published Gemini CLI record at version 0.8.2 and no longer syncing with it; hundreds of files still carry the upstream copyright alongside the fork's own. The vocabulary has no model-backend identifier for the maintainer's own models, so its native backend cannot be recorded.
strengths: The permission layer reasons about shell semantics and destructive commands rather than matching tool names, and is tested
Sandboxed execution through containers and hand-written platform profiles, in a role where most published records run on the host only
Reach no published coding agent matches, spanning a desktop app, three editor integrations, three language libraries, and messaging channels
weaknesses: Surface area outruns evidence, with several client packages thin relative to the core and two excluded from the main build
The headline installation path pipes a vendor-hosted script from a cloud bucket into a shell
Licence provenance needs care, with hundreds of core files still carrying the upstream author's copyright and three open licences across the tree
why_it_matters: Shows a provider fork outgrowing its upstream, stopping its syncs and adding sandboxed execution, subagents, and a far wider client surface than the record it descends from.
